currentContext.business: The Company operates an Explosives Division and a Perlite Division. The explosives business covers products such as cartridge explosives, bulk emulsion explosives, Mono Methyl Amine Nitrate (MMAN) solutions and accessories, with Ammonium Nitrate as the key raw material, sold into PSUs, the dealers segment and Institution (New MDO's) customers as well as into export markets. The Perlite Division supplies Perlite Filter-Aid, with diversification underway into the pharma sector, along with Horticulture Mixes and perlite products, has developed specific products for cashew and blueberry for the tissue culture industry, and has executed various insulation projects catering to India's growth in the cryogenic market.

currentContext.expansion: Capacity work in FY2025-26 was concentrated in the Explosives Division. The Company states that it has already set up an Accessories Project at its Garamsur location, and that overall infrastructure has been improved at Vishwasnagar, Garamsur and other Units. The MD&A Outlook records that a new plant was commissioned in March 2026 and is expected to stabilise, which management says will support continued growth alongside its export focus. Under technology absorption, the Company discloses that imported technology for Nitration Based Accessories is not yet fully absorbed as it is under implementation and is to be commissioned fully in 2027; PETN, Detonating Fuse and Cast Booster products have been produced and supplied with fully indigenous equipment. In the Perlite Division expansion is application- and market-led rather than plant-led: Filter-Aid diversification into new market areas with more focus on the pharma sector for higher volumes, specific products developed for cashew and blueberry for the tissue culture industry, and execution of various insulation projects catering to India's growth in the cryogenic market. R&D expenditure for the year was Capital NIL and Recurring Rs. 130.94 Lakhs, with the stated future plan of action being to continue development work on Explosives and explore new businesses for diversification. The narrative chapters carry no project cost, no capacity addition figure and no installed-capacity table; the only rupee capex quanta in the document arrive as named statutory disclosures (the segment note's Capital expenditure row and the Note 31 Capital Commitments row).

risks.note: Named by management in MD&A 'Risks and Concerns' as a risk the Company faces. Explosives manufacturing is a licensed, safety-critical process dependent on trained personnel, and the Company separately says more focus is made on training's and skill development of employees to further enhance safety.

risks.risk: Competition in the domestic and local markets
risks.note: Named in MD&A 'Risks and Concerns'. The Company says it has approached eminent experts to identify market risks and take pro-active actions, and in Perlite is diversifying into new areas of market to hold volumes.

risks.risk: Stringent government regulations with respect to license and safety
risks.note: Named in MD&A 'Risks and Concerns'. Manufacture of explosives is licence-dependent, so any tightening or lapse of licence and safety conditions is a structural constraint on operating the Vishwasnagar, Garamsur and other Units.

risks.risk: Manufacturing risks across the various manufacturing locations
risks.note: The Company states it has identified manufacturing risks at its various manufacturing locations and took appropriate measures to minimize the same; safety has been the primary focus on all production activities and processes have been strengthened from time to time to enhance safety.

The Company has approached eminent experts to identify market risks and take pro-active actions, indicating market exposure is treated as a live risk rather than an internal-only assessment. Business risk evaluation and management is described as an ongoing process, with the Board informed of risk assessment and minimization procedures.

risks.risk: Dependence on Ammonium Nitrate as the key raw material
risks.note: The MD&A Industry Overview states the key raw material for manufacturing of explosives is Ammonium Nitrate, making the Explosives Division structurally exposed to that single input even though the Company does not itself label it a risk.

risks.risk: Reliance on PSU customers for Bulk Explosives volumes, and on government infrastructure/mining spend for demand
risks.note: Segment-wise performance attributes the volume of Bulk Explosives to the Company's continued presence in PSU's. The Outlook ties industry growth to emphasis on infrastructure growth and mining by the Govt., with growth drivers being mining, construction and infrastructure, and states Various Government Initiatives and Investment in manufacturing and infrastructure sectors will be crucial for the increasing demand — a policy- and capex-cycle-driven demand base.

risks.risk: Stabilisation of the newly commissioned plant alongside an export-led focus
risks.note: The Outlook states that during the Financial Year 2025-26 the Company's focus is majorly into exports and that the New plant commissioned in March 2026 is expected to stabilise, with these steps said to ensure continued growth — so near-term growth rests on that ramp and on export demand. The Board separately states there is no risk identified which in its opinion may threaten the existence of the Company.
